fetch_github_endpoint: make an authenticated GET request to a GitHub API endpoint using a bearer token from config
fetch_repo_issues: fetch all issues from a GitHub repo with optional date filters and return a pandas DataFrame
fetch_repo_stats: fetch repository statistics including open issues count, stars, and forks from a GitHub repo
validate_df_values: normalize DataFrame column names to lowercase snake case and optionally export to CSV
review_utils: review the GitHub triage utility functions for fetching issues, stats, and validating DataFrames
